summary: iter-114 pairing/installer hardening verified end-to-end. Backend: existing pytest 13/13 PASS + NEW HTTP contract suite 13/13 PASS. Verified: (1) POST /api/infra/pairing stores code_digest (64 chars, no plaintext), returns rotated pairing code + eadep_ id + digest note; (2) claim without terminal -> 400 'exactly one MT5 terminal must be selected'; claim with {terminal_path, host_fingerprint} -> 200 with installation_id (inst_...), ROTATED bridge_token (differs from original), connected=false, lease_seconds=20; re-claim -> 401 (already claimed); (3) re-pair while lease active -> 409 with 'active execution owner'; with revoke_existing:true -> 200 and pymongo confirms old installation revoked=true; (4) GET /api/infra/ea-deployments returns states ladder of exactly 10, lease_seconds=20, per-deployment connected/execution_owner/lease_active fields; (5) POST /api/infra/ea-deploy/progress with registered agent token: state ARTIFACT_VERIFIED then EA_INSTALLED advance (200); state TOKEN_CLAIMED -> 400 'agents may only report' set; (6) connect-existing response install_commands.recommended has NO 'quick' key and no 'irm'/'| iex' substrings; (7) GET /api/infra/artifacts/manifest contains stoic-ea-ex5 (ex5 type) with 'never recompile' note; (8) POST /api/infra/agents/{id}/commands install_ea without terminal_path -> 400 'one terminal per account'; with terminal_path+account_ref -> queued. Frontend: login as admin -> /infrastructure loads; after seeding a pairing for a synthetic admin account, [data-testid=ea-deployments-card] renders with header 'EA DEPLOYMENTS · CONNECTED ONLY AFTER A VERIFIED HEARTBEAT', the one-account -> one-installation -> one-terminal -> one-host note (lease 20s), and shows NOT CONNECTED — TOKEN ISSUED status; all 9 ladder chips visible (TOKEN ISSUED / TOKEN CLAIMED / HOST INSPECTED / TERMINAL SELECTED / ARTIFACT VERIFIED / EA INSTALLED / EA HEARTBEAT RECEIVED / BROKER ACCOUNT VERIFIED / READY FOR SHADOW). Confirmed CONNECTED (green) label never shown (no heartbeat yet). Regressions: deployment-jobs list, failure-matrix-card, shadow-certification all render; Path A/B wizard opens (pathB present in wizard).
critical_code_review_comments: vps_agent.claim_pairing_code returns 401 vs 400 in infra_routes via string sniff 'terminal' in str(e) — fragile but low risk (only two ValueError paths in the function). Consider a typed error to keep 401/400 mapping stable.

on_ea_heartbeat renews the execution-owner lease unconditionally on a valid bridge heartbeat regardless of terminal/host match — that is by design (installation is already terminal-bound at claim), but consider persisting the last observed host_fingerprint on the lease and refusing renewal if it differs, as an extra defense-in-depth guard for iter-115+.

GET /api/infra/artifacts/manifest is public and now advertises an .ex5 artifact — good. But there is no ETag / Cache-Control (already noted in iter-98) and no signed URL for the .ex5 download itself; when the CI-built .ex5 becomes downloadable, ensure a signed/pinned URL rather than raw file server access.

advance_ea_deployment is forward-only via DEPLOY_STATES.index() — correct. But state 'FAILED' is placed LAST in DEPLOY_STATES (index 9). The current code allows FAILED to be set from any earlier state (special-cased with `state != 'FAILED'`), which is correct, but the ladder chip renderer filters out FAILED (s !== 'FAILED') for the chip strip — verified working.
